basic_details.job_title: District Health Society, Erode Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 31 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Health Society, Erode (Health and Family Welfare Department) invites applications for 31 Staff Nurse posts on contract basis, purely temporary in nature, as per NHM norms, at a monthly remuneration of Rs.21,000/-. Candidates up to 50 years of age with GNM or B.Sc.Nursing and valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council must send the filled form with photocopies of documents so that it reaches the Executive Secretary, District Health Society, Erode, by 04 December 2026, 5:00 PM.

important_instructions: Selected candidates will be placed as per G.O.(Ms) No.427, Health and Family Welfare EAP-II/1 Department, dated 18.11.2026. The engagement is purely temporary and does not give any right to claim regularization. The notice gives the office telephone number as 0424-2431020 (read from the Tamil text).

content_sections.heading: About District Health Society, Erode
content_sections.text: District Health Society, Erode works under the Health and Family Welfare Department; its notice is signed by the Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, and the Chairman is the District Collector. The society's office is at Thindal, Erode 638012. This engagement is made through the society under NHM norms.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post with 31 vacancies. It prints no category-wise break-up. The posts are in CEmONC institutions, including SNCU and PICU, under the Directorate of Medical and Rural Health Services and the Directorate of Medical Education & Research.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The age limit is "Upto 50 years". The notice prints no age relaxation, no age cut-off date and no experience requirement. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the full eligibility details.

rows.post: Staff Nurse (on contract basis under NHM)
rows.qualification_required: GNM / B.Sc.Nursing from Government or Government-approved Private Nursing College, recognised by the university approved under state norms. Valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly remuneration is Rs.21,000/-. The engagement is purely temporary on contract basis under NHM and does not confer any right to claim regularization. The notice does not state the length of the contract.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Health Society, Erode Staff Nurse (on contract basis under NHM)
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the district website, https://erode.nic.in . Fill in the application form. Attach photocopies of the relevant documents. Address it to The Executive Secretary/District Health Officer, District Health Society, Thindal, Erode 638012. Make sure it reaches that address on or before 04.12.2026, 5:00 PM. The notice states that applications "should reach" the office by this deadline. It does not name a mode of sending such as post or hand delivery.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed as per G.O.(Ms) No.427, Health and Family Welfare EAP-II/1 Department, dated 18.11.2026. The engagement is purely temporary and does not give any right to claim regularization. The notice gives the office telephone number as 0424-2431020 (read from the Tamil text).
